$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFSM (AIP France, chart dated 2024-05-16): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Montbéliard - Courcelles

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

service.atsHours: AFIS : LUN-VEN / MON-FRI : 0730-1100, 1300-1700. En dehors de ces HOR, ainsi que SAM, DIM et JF : PPR la veille ou le dernier jour ouvrable avant 1600. Out of these SKED and SAT, SUN and HOL : PPR before 1600 on the day before or on the last working day (UTC HIV ; HOR ETE : -1HR)

preferredQfuReason: preferred QFU 257, due to IFR procedure
notes: Possible IFR operations.
AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
Simultaneous use of RWY prohibited.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Preferred QFU: 257° due to IFR procedure.
Due to obstacles, curved approach by South at the QFU 077°.
Very noise sensitive AD, imperatively avoid overfly neighbouring inhabited areas.
After TKOF RWY 26, turn left to overfly the area between the Doubs and the Canal du Rhône au Rhin.
After TKOF RWY 08, turn right because of the tree, ALT 1234 ft, 078° / 1 NM ARP.
TWY A and TWY B are limited to ACFT with a main gear overall width smaller than 5 meters.
At night, only East funnel is usable at TKOF and at landing.
Night use is prohibited when the PAPI is unavailable.
Night training flight is reserved for pilots with agreement from AD operator.

PCL for lighting and PAPI: 3 clicks on microphone for low intensity lighting.; 5 clicks on microphone for high intensity lighting.; 7 clicks on microphone in less than 5 seconds to switch off the lighting.;.
Automatic extinguishing 13 min 40 s.
PJE on AD (NR 248): SUM: 0600-SS, WIN: 0700-SS, FL 145.
PPR from BALE INFO above 6500 ft AMSL.
Aerobatics on AD (NR 6470): 0730-1800 (SUM: -1HR), daytime only; RWY 08/26 centerline on 1700 m; 1650 ft ASFC/5500 ft AMSL; usable only for pilots authorized by AD operator.
AEM (NR 8056): 500 ft ASFC.
Hot air balloon flight near the AD: activity announced on A/A FREQ.
